SCEJS
============

<h1>Multipurpose Javascript 3D graphic library</h1>

SCEJS is a Scene-Graph which use <a href="https://github.com/stormcolor/webclgl">WebCLGL</a> and <a href="https://github.com/stormcolor/nclgl">NCLGL</a> to facilitate perform advanced algorithms on GPU.
<h3>Current Algorithms:</h3>
<h3>GPU Neural Network (<a href="https://github.com/stormcolor/gbrain">gbrain</a>)</h3>
- Method to perform GPU backward/forward along entire Neural Network layers with an Adjacency Matrix instead send data layer by layer. (March 31 2018)<br />
- <a href="https://github.com/karpathy/convnetjs">ConvNetJS</a> Reinforcement Learning module integration. (March 31 2018)
<h3>GPU Graph (<a href="https://github.com/stormcolor/ggraph">ggraph</a>)</h3>
- WebGL Graph visualization and Real Time Force Layout using Adjacency Matrix.
<h3>GPU Path Tracing (<a href="https://github.com/stormcolor/gpath">gpath</a>)</h3>
- Tool to voxelizate triangles meshes using WebGL top view for celling creation<br />
- Hybrid PathTracing using voxels instead triangles.
